literature.title: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis preceding polyarticular juvenile rheumatoid arthritis.
literature.abstract: We describe the case of a 12-year-old girl who developed lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis at 2 years of age which preceded polyarticular rheumatoid factor (RF) positive juvenile arthritis. Her disease had a chronic active course, but showed a good response to combination therapy. The pathogenesis of these two immune processes and of the lung involvement in juvenile arthritis is discussed.

literature.abstract: Methotrexate is successfully used in the treatment of arthritis but little is known about its effects on extra-articular manifestations of rheumatoid arthritis. We focused this work on the incidence and clinical course of extra-articular manifestations during long-term treatment with methotrexate.

literature.abstract: Tocilizumab is a monoclonal antibody directed against the interleukin-6 receptor, which is approved for the treatment of moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis. literature.abstract: Extra-articular involvement (EAI) in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is rare, severe and usually presents after years of joint involvement. Onset of RA as lung involvement has been published. We describe a series of three patients with strongly positive anti-citrullinated peptide antibodies (ACPA) and rheumatoid factor (RF) positive in the absence of joint symptoms, but with significant EAI.
